```{r}
#| include: false
SCENARIO_AUDIT <- fread(file.path(root, "data", "audit", "summary.csv"))
SCENARIO_MASTER <- fread(file.path(root, "data", "records", "scenarios", "IMW.csv"))
SCENARIO_COMPLETE <- unique(SCENARIO_MASTER$ScenarioID)
if (!nrow(SCENARIO_AUDIT) || !length(SCENARIO_COMPLETE)) {
  stop("scenarios.executive.qmd: scenario audit and inventory must be non-empty.")
}
if (!setequal(SCENARIO_AUDIT$ScenarioID, SCENARIO_COMPLETE)) {
  stop("scenarios.executive.qmd: audit and generated scenario inventory do not match.")
}
SCENARIO_AUDIT[, p := sub("^.*\\.(p[0-9]+)$", "\\1", ScenarioID)]
SCENARIO_N <- nrow(SCENARIO_AUDIT)
SCENARIO_D <- range(SCENARIO_AUDIT$D)
SCENARIO_Q <- range(SCENARIO_AUDIT$MIC)
SCENARIO_REALIZATIONS <- range(SCENARIO_AUDIT$n.records)
SCENARIO_REALIZATION_N <- data.table::uniqueN(
  SCENARIO_MASTER[, .(ScenarioID, RecordID)]
)
if (SCENARIO_REALIZATION_N != sum(SCENARIO_AUDIT$n.records)) {
  stop("scenarios.executive.qmd: inconsistent scenario realization inventory.")
}
SCENARIO_REALIZATION_TEXT <- if (
  SCENARIO_REALIZATIONS[1L] == SCENARIO_REALIZATIONS[2L]
) {
  sprintf("Each condition contains %d realizations.", SCENARIO_REALIZATIONS[1L])
} else {
  sprintf(
    "Each condition contains between %d and %d realizations.",
    SCENARIO_REALIZATIONS[1L], SCENARIO_REALIZATIONS[2L]
  )
}
SCENARIO_P <- SCENARIO_AUDIT[, sort(unique(p))]
SCENARIO_P_TEXT <- paste(SCENARIO_P, collapse = ", ")
SCENARIO_P_LABEL <- if (length(SCENARIO_P) == 1L) {
  "predictive level"
} else {
  "predictive levels"
}
SCENARIO_PPV_L <- range(SCENARIO_AUDIT$SF.L)
SCENARIO_PPV_T <- range(SCENARIO_AUDIT$SF.T)
SCENARIO_PPV_V <- range(SCENARIO_AUDIT$SF.V)
```

The evaluated family comprises `r SCENARIO_N` scenarios on a discrete grid of distances from `r formatC(SCENARIO_D[1L], format = "f", digits = 0L)` to `r formatC(SCENARIO_D[2L], format = "f", digits = 0L)` m and MIC values from `r formatC(SCENARIO_Q[1L], format = "f", digits = 0L)` to `r formatC(SCENARIO_Q[2L], format = "f", digits = 0L)` kg, for the `r SCENARIO_P_LABEL` $`r SCENARIO_P_TEXT`$. `r SCENARIO_REALIZATION_TEXT` The family contains `r formatC(SCENARIO_REALIZATION_N, format = "d", big.mark = ",")` three-component realizations in total, one per scenario--source-record combination.

The PPV targets span `r formatC(SCENARIO_PPV_L[1L], format = "f", digits = 2L)`--`r formatC(SCENARIO_PPV_L[2L], format = "f", digits = 2L)` mm/s in L, `r formatC(SCENARIO_PPV_T[1L], format = "f", digits = 2L)`--`r formatC(SCENARIO_PPV_T[2L], format = "f", digits = 2L)` mm/s in T, and `r formatC(SCENARIO_PPV_V[1L], format = "f", digits = 2L)`--`r formatC(SCENARIO_PPV_V[2L], format = "f", digits = 2L)` mm/s in V.
